description: Fill an input by its label or placeholder text — no CSS selector needed. Finds input by associated label, placeholder, aria-label, name, or id. React-compatible value setting. Use when you know WHAT field to fill but not the exact selector.

label.description: Label or placeholder text of the input (e.g. 'Email', 'Password', 'Search')

value.description: Value to fill in the input

name: browser_smart_fill
